title: Playtest stopped working suddenly? [ VX Ace on Linux Mint]

posts.author: MysteryMouse
posts.body: I've been working on a game in RPG Maker VX Ace on and off for a few years now and have never had this issue before. But when I went to playtest the game it suddenly didn't work right. The music still play's and I can tell the game is running, as I can press play and it loads the intro, all the sound effects play. But everything is black. I have a screenshot of the game on the title screen (though you'd never be able to tell) and what it should look like. Is it a Linux Mint thing? A VX Ace thing? And is there a way I can fix it. Because I do not want to start over.

posts.author: MysteryMouse
posts.body: Update: Fixed itself? I literally did nothing and it started working again. Now I am very confused, happy cause I can play test for bugs. But still confused.

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body: There's a chance that Wine had a z-coordinate issue and it didn't display all graphics the way it was intended. It might happen if your Linux box is low on RAM at that point or you're depending on a generic Intel graphics card, etc.
